question: What is Qwen3.5-0.8B (Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B on Hugging Face)? When was it released, how many layers and parameters, what tokenizer and vocab size, is it a base or instruct model, and does it support tool calling?
answer: Qwen3.5-0.8B is a natively multimodal causal language model capable of processing text, images, and video [1][2]. It was released on March 2, 2026 [2]. The model features 0.8 billion parameters and 24 layers [1][3]. It uses a vocabulary size of 248,320 tokens [1][2]. The model is available as both a base model (Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base) for research and fine-tuning and a post-trained instruction-tuned version [1][4]. It supports tool calling, which can be enabled using specialized parsers like qwen3_coder in environments such as vLLM or SGLang [1][5].
